description: Na₄LuC₃O₉F crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 67-71°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.40 Å. There is one shorter (2.27 Å) and one longer (2.28 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.74 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.59 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one F atom to form NaO₅F octahedra that share corners with two NaO₄F₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one LuO₅F₂ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two NaO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 67-79°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.44 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.31 Å. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 71-79°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.61 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.41 Å.
